detail.longDescription:
One strike against OpenAI Dots already: availability.

Dots launch for Pro and up. Meta Muse launched free for everyone from day one.

I’m excited to try Dots, but putting a new agent experience behind higher-tier plans limits who gets to experiment with it.

Accessibility isn’t the only kind of access that matters.

What do you think? Should new AI agent experiences launch broadly, or does starting with paid users make sense?

#AI #OpenAI #Meta #AIAgents
